name: POS Membership Card
description: With the help of this app, The user can create the category of cards such as gold or silver and can define category-based discounts so whenever such customer shows his card to the cashier he will get a discount on the whole order based on his category.
summary: This app lets you create customer card categories such as Gold or Silver and set category-based discounts. When a customer presents their card, the system automatically applies the discount to their entire order based on their category. Simplify loyalty management, reward customers, and boost sales with ease. With the help of this app, users can create categories of membership cards such as Gold, Silver, or Bronze, and define category based discounts. Whenever a customer presents their membership card to the cashier, the system automatically applies the discount to the entire order based on their category. The POS Membership Card module for Odoo empowers your Point of Sale system with a loyalty-driven discount mechanism through digital membership cards. Retailers can assign customers to different membership tiers (e.g., Gold, Silver, Bronze) and apply fixed discounts accordingly. This feature simplifies loyalty reward execution, streamlines checkout, and encourages repeat business by offering exclusive, tier-based pricing. name: Point of Sale Carry Bag
description: This app will add a carry bag to an order with just one click.Whether you offer plastic bags, paper bags, eco-friendly totes, or branded shopping bags, this module makes it effortless to manage and sell them at checkout. It works seamlessly in supermarkets, clothing stores, bookshops, pharmacies, and other retail outlets where carry bags are often sold alongside purchases.

Whether you offer plastic bags, paper bags, eco-friendly totes, or branded shopping bags, this module makes it effortless to manage and sell them at checkout. name: POS Multiple Quantity
description: Once this module is installed and 'POS multiple Quantity' is enabled, then you can use the functionality of this module.Functionality is that you can set a number of product quantity in POS. When Add product than add multiple product in orderline. Also you can set a number as multiple Quantity for all Products.
summary: The POS Multiple Quantity module for Odoo enables you to define product quantities that are automatically added to the order line in the Point of Sale. Once activated, you can set specific multiple quantities per product or apply a default quantity for all products. This feature helps speed up checkout, ensures consistent sales quantities, and simplifies retail operations. The POS Multiple Quantity module for Odoo enhances your Point of Sale system by enabling automatic product entry in predefined multiples. Instead of adding just one unit per click, the system adds a configured multiple quantity reducing repetitive input, minimizing errors, and speeding up checkout in high-volume sales environments. This feature is especially useful for wholesale, grocery stores, bakeries, restaurants, and retail chains, where items are commonly sold in packs, batches, or fixed multiples. summary: The POS Minimum Quantity module for Odoo allows you to set minimum order quantities directly in the Point of Sale. Once enabled, it ensures that a predefined minimum quantity of a product is automatically added to the order line when selected. You can also configure a default minimum quantity for all products, helping standardize sales and improve efficiency at checkout. The POS Minimum Quantity module for Odoo allows you to define and enforce minimum product quantities directly in your Point of Sale system. Instead of adding a single unit by default, the POS automatically applies the predefined minimum quantity whenever a product is added to the order line. This feature ensures consistent sales practices, improves stock control, and simplifies bulk sales by reducing manual input for cashiers. Businesses can configure either a global minimum quantity that applies to all products or define individual minimum quantities per product for more flexibility. Perfect for retailers, wholesale outlets, grocery stores, restaurants, and businesses selling in bulk, this module standardizes transactions and prevents under-selling.
